meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 当您让它发布新版本时,它会自动更新八处配置文件里的版本号、运行构建校验、提交并打 Git 标签、创建 GitHub Release、重新生成变更日志、发送 Discord 通知,最后把 npm 发布这一步留给您手动完成。
howto.when: 当您要求它为 Claude Code 插件升级版本或发布新版本时触发。

say.text: 把这个插件从 1.2.3 升到 1.3.0 并发布。
say.note: 将自动更新所有清单并走完整发布流程。

say.text: 帮我执行一次 PATCH 版本发布。
say.note: 按修复级别递增版本并发布。

say.text: 发布新版本并生成变更日志。
say.note: 会重新生成 CHANGELOG.md 并推送。

howto.what_en: When asked to release, it updates versions in eight config files, builds, commits and tags, creates a GitHub release, regenerates the changelog, sends a Discord notification, and leaves npm publish to you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to bump the version or release a new version of a Claude Code plugin.

say_en.text: Bump this plugin from 1.2.3 to 1.3.0 and release it.
say_en.note: Runs the full release flow including build and tagging.
Increments as a fix and publishes the plugin.

say_en.text: Release a new version and update the changelog.
